```{python}
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import geopandas as gpd
import rasterio
from rasterio.windows import Window

lines = gpd.read_file("data/reach/centerlines.geojson").to_crs(2856)

def sample_low(src, x, y, half=10):
    row, col = src.index(x, y)
    win = Window(col - half, row - half, 2 * half + 1, 2 * half + 1)
    vals = src.read(1, window=win, boundless=True, fill_value=np.nan)
    if np.all(np.isnan(vals)):
        return np.nan
    return np.nanpercentile(vals, 5)

rows = []
with rasterio.open("data/processed/dtm_2020_1m.tif") as src:
    for name, line in zip(lines.gnis_name, lines.geometry):
        for d in np.arange(0, line.length, 25):
            p = line.interpolate(d)
            rows.append({"river": name, "dist_m": d, "x": p.x, "y": p.y,
                         "z": sample_low(src, p.x, p.y)})

pts = pd.DataFrame(rows)
pts.groupby("river").z.describe()
```
```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

profiles = []
for name, g in pts.dropna().groupby("river"):
    g = g.sort_values("dist_m")
    if g.z.iloc[0] < g.z.iloc[-1]:
        g = g.iloc[::-1]
    g = g.copy()
    g["down_km"] = np.arange(len(g)) * 25 / 1000
    g["z_ws"] = np.minimum.accumulate(g.z.values)
    profiles.append(g)
prof = pd.concat(profiles)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4))
for ax, (name, g) in zip(axes, prof.groupby("river")):
    ax.plot(g.down_km, g.z, ".", ms=3, color="grey", label="DTM low point")
    ax.plot(g.down_km, g.z_ws, color="tab:blue", label="water surface")
    ax.set_title(name)
    ax.set_xlabel("km downstream")
    ax.set_ylabel("elevation (m, NAVD88)")
    ax.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
```
```{python}
from rasterio.transform import Affine
from rasterio.warp import reproject, Resampling
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree

tree = cKDTree(prof[["x", "y"]].values)
z_river = prof["z_ws"].values

with rasterio.open("data/processed/dtm_2020_1m.tif") as src:
    dtm = src.read(1)
    meta = src.profile
    t = src.transform

# water surface on a coarse 10 m grid
step = 10
ch, cw = int(np.ceil(dtm.shape[0] / step)), int(np.ceil(dtm.shape[1] / step))
coarse_t = t * Affine.scale(step)
cx = coarse_t.c + (np.arange(cw) + 0.5) * step
cy = coarse_t.f - (np.arange(ch) + 0.5) * step
X, Y = np.meshgrid(cx, cy)

dist, idx = tree.query(np.column_stack([X.ravel(), Y.ravel()]), k=48)
w = 1 / np.maximum(dist, 1) ** 2
ws_coarse = (np.sum(w * z_river[idx], axis=1) / np.sum(w, axis=1)).reshape(ch, cw)
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter
ws_coarse = gaussian_filter(ws_coarse, sigma=15)

# back to 1 m, then subtract
ws = np.empty_like(dtm)
reproject(ws_coarse.astype("float32"), ws,
          src_transform=coarse_t, dst_transform=t,
          src_crs=meta["crs"], dst_crs=meta["crs"],
          resampling=Resampling.bilinear)
rem = dtm - ws

meta.update(dtype="float32", compress="deflate")
with rasterio.open("data/processed/rem_2020_1m.tif", "w", **meta) as dst:
    dst.write(rem.astype("float32"), 1)

np.nanpercentile(rem, [1, 25, 50, 75, 99]).round(2)
```
```{python}
from rasterio.transform import array_bounds

south_west_east_north = array_bounds(dtm.shape[0], dtm.shape[1], t)
west, south, east, north = south_west_east_north
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 9))
im = ax.imshow(rem[::4, ::4], cmap="YlGnBu", vmin=0, vmax=8,
               extent=(west, east, south, north))
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, label="height above river (m)", shrink=0.6)
ax.set_title("Relative elevation model, 2020")
```
